rules.statement: The measure has a calendar-year contract; it renews automatically unless deregistered.
At least one eligible animal is required in every funding year.

result.description: Measure contract lapses if the minimum is missed.

rules.statement: Only purebred breeding animals of the Annex-D list qualify.

result.description: Animal can be funded subject to all remaining duties.

rules.statement: Female animals require regular programme breeding use and purebred mating, plus species-specific birth history.

conditions.description: Cow calved, mare foaled, ewe lambed, doe kidded, or sow farrowed by prescribed date.

rules.statement: Male animals require regular programme breeding use and applicable minimum age or offspring proof.

conditions.description: Annual breeding use except admission year; applicable age and stallion offspring requirements.

rules.statement: In normal years requested animals must be held from 1 April through 31 December.
For 2026, holding through 31 August suffices; movements through year-end remain reportable and replacement reporting after 31 August is unnecessary.

result.description: Premium remains payable after departure from 1 September.

rules.statement: The responsible breeding organisation must confirm by 10 February of the following year Zuchtbuch entry, category requirements, approved programme and cow milk recording.
Apply before contract start in the measures application by 31 December; final entry is funding year 2027 with application by 31 December 2026.
Horses, sheep, goats and pigs are individually applied for at 1 April; cattle and replacements are drawn automatically from the cattle database.
Departure of applied horses, sheep, goats or pigs is reported to AMA online within seven days; cattle database reporting replaces this.

conditions.description: Sale, death or slaughter during required holding period.

rules.statement: Departed horses, sheep, goats and pigs must be replaced within five weeks by eligible same-breed animals and reported within seven days of replacement; deadlines may cross year-end.

result.description: Replacement must meet every obligation at replacement time.

rules.statement: Temporary transfer is limited to six months at a breeding station or three months for male breeding use on another farm; no report is needed for documented absence up to ten days.

result.description: AMA breeding-use notice before transfer except documented short absence.

rules.statement: Cattle may be transferred after 30 September if not exported, slaughtered or dead before 1 January of the following year.
Temporary stay on leased, alpine or common pasture is not departure where disposal remains with the applicant or handover is only for care.
Eligible Annex-D breeds with special genetic-conservation programme receive the automatic supplement when their breeding association implements it.
Cow milk-recording supplement is automatically determined and needs no separate application.
Premium is per eligible animal and depends on application year, animal category, breed tier and automatic supplements.

result.description: Base plus eligible GEP and milk-recording supplements.

rules.statement: Funded animals must be kept in Austria.
Measure takeover is only possible in individual cases upon farm dissolution, division or merger; animals and areas must originate from the same predecessor farm.
Withdrawal is possible after the one-year term, but a deregistration made within a calendar year makes the measure invalid for that funding year.

conditions.description: Online notification in current multiple application.

result.description: Deregister only from 1 January following completion to retain the year.

rules.statement: A beneficiary must manage an agricultural holding in its own name and at its own expense, have the required land disposal power, and meet active-farmer and agricultural-activity conditions.

result.description: May participate subject to measure requirements.

rules.statement: In the first ÖPUL participation year, the holding must have either 0.50 ha protected cultivation or 1.50 ha qualifying agricultural area; this general minimum does not apply from the second participation year.
All ÖPUL participants must comply with climate/environment, public-health, plant-health, animal-welfare and social conditionality to receive the full payment.

Control findings can lead to warning or 2, 5, 10, 25, 50 or 100 percent reduction; a second 100-percent reduction during the contract period entails exclusion and recovery, while a warning becomes 1 percent from 2027.

conditions.description: Severity, extent, duration and frequency are assessed.

result.description: Individual level is not determinable from the supplied generic scale alone.

rules.statement: Funding is an annual premium, paid by AMA to the declared account by 30 June of the following year; a partial payment up to 75 percent may follow completed administrative controls.
